findings.text: texts() and check() (working-workers.py:28, :58) re-implement the figure text-clipping, label-overlap and label-over-data guard that docs/figures/a-project-reads-as-one-picture/work-in-flight-sits-on-its-section/section_row_readers.py:74 and docs/figures/a-review-dies-where-nobody-is-looking/a-local-worker-compacts-and-continues-measured/plot_compaction_drops.py:96 already carry; this addition duplicates rather than extends either, so a repair to the guard reaches one figure of three.

the claims table reports the held claim as '451 of 496' passes while the committed census output the record cites beside it (work-flows-to-the-lane-s67.census.json:44) records "passes": 878 for that path, because scripts/lane_window_census.py:505-507 increments the per-path passes field once per claim pointer; a reader reconciling the record with its artifact sees 878 passes in a 496-pass window. The gate figure itself (0 of 496 shared-root holds) is unaffected.
